system.description:
You acquire one skill from a skill list other than from your Archetype Class, Main Class, or Race. You can acquire only one General-tagged skill, but may raise that skill's SR normally.

(Bonus): Reduce your [Max HP] by -10.

You can “disguise” yourself as another race or occupation and use your special skills with the blessing of the tail of the fox-tail tribe, which holds the power of transformation.
